headline: Moonshot AI releases Kimi-K3 on HuggingFace 7/27, the world's first open 3T-class model
summary: Moonshot AI has launched Kimi-K3, an open 3T-class model on HuggingFace. It is designed for advanced capabilities in long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and complex reasoning tasks.
details: Moonshot AI has officially released Kimi-K3, an open frontier model now available on HuggingFace. This marks the debut of the world's first open 3T-class model, setting a new benchmark for AI capabilities.

Kimi-K3 is engineered for frontier intelligence across various demanding applications. Its design focuses on long-horizon coding, intricate knowledge work, and advanced reasoning tasks. The model's weights are expected to be public on July 27th.
caption:
Moonshot AI has unveiled Kimi-K3, the world's first open 3T-class model. It's now available on HuggingFace for advanced coding and reasoning.

Moonshot AI has officially released Kimi-K3, an open frontier model now available on HuggingFace. This marks the debut of the world's first open 3T-class model, setting a new benchmark for AI capabilities.

Kimi-K3 is engineered for frontier intelligence across various demanding applications. Its design focuses on long-horizon coding, intricate knowledge work, and advanced reasoning tasks. The model's weights are expected to be public on July 27th.
